title: ConfidenceScore
description: Synthetic confidence score from weighted multi-source evaluation

reviewer_confidence.description: Average reviewer-stated confidence mapped to 0-100 scale (weight: 0.20)

evidence_quality.description: Percentage of findings with valid evidence_path (weight: 0.25)

validator_agreement.description: 100 if validators pass, 0 if any fail (weight: 0.25)

cross_reviewer_convergence.description: 100 if all reviewers agree on verdict, 60 if ≤2 disagree, 20 if >2 (weight: 0.15)

repair_history.description: 100 if no repair rounds, 70 if <max, 30 if max reached (weight: 0.15)
